title: Sleep Now, June (to the tune of Silent Night)
how: New words of our own under the old notes: one syllable per sung note (a _ note carries the syllable before it), line for line (score.cjs counts them). A made-up family.

lines.syl: Hol- lis- ters gath- ered by fire- light

lines.text: Little sister, so cozy and warm

Sleep in Grand- mo- ther's arms
love from the Hol- lis- ters
